from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790689794/attempts/a536beb1a07649f1b9f85ee1d72dd80c/system/state/workspace/programs/task-baf79431.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = [[bg for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    seen = set()
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == bg or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            cells = []
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                cells.append((y, x))
                for yy, xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= yy < h and 0 <= xx < w and (yy, xx) not in seen and grid[yy][xx] == color:
                        seen.add((yy, xx))
                        q.append((yy, xx))
            if len(cells) < 2:
                continue
            rs = [y for y, x in cells]
            cs = [x for y, x in cells]
            r0, r1, c0, c1 = min(rs), max(rs), min(cs), max(cs)
            area = (r1-r0+1)*(c1-c0+1)
            # Retain substantial colored objects and repair isolated intrusions
            # in near-solid rectangular objects.
            for y, x in cells:
                out[y][x] = color
            if area > 1 and len(cells) / area >= 0.70:
                for y in range(r0, r1+1):
                    for x in range(c0, c1+1):
                        out[y][x] = color
    return out
'''
p.write_text(source)
print(p)
